simple.meaning: גֵּאוּת (gêʼûwth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “the same as 1346.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Psalms 17:10. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֵּאוּת (H1348) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: גֵּאוּת (gêʼûwth) / H1348 is traced through Psalms 17:10, Psalms 89:10, Psalms 93:1, Isaiah 9:17 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: They close up their callous hearts.

timeline.evidenceText: They close up their callous hearts.
You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain.
Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men,
Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
Let favor be shown to the wicked,
Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!
The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.

definitions.full: H1348. geuth גֵּאוּת noun feminine majesty , Psa 93:1 7t.; — 1 lifting up עָשָׁן גֵּאוּת column of smoke Isa 9:17 ; הַיָּם גֵּאוּת swelling of the sea Psa 89:10 . 2 majesty of God Psa 93:1 ; Isa 26:10 ; עָשָׂה גֵּאוּת he hath done majestically 12:5 ; גֵּאוּת עֲטֶרֶת crown of majesty 28:1 , 3 (Samaria, on a round hill majestically commanding the country). 3 pride בְגֵאוּת דִּבְּרוּ they speak proudly Psa 17:10 ; so for נְאוֺת 74:20 Bi Che.
